summary.headline: Lunar Aspects in Illness
summary.text: Astrological rules for illness and recovery based on the Moon’s aspects and motion, including configurations with Mars, Saturn, Sun, Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus. The passage treats the Moon in Leo and discusses benefic and malefic aspects, nodes, angular relationships, confinement, cholera, heart disease, and other maladies.
